ModMetaData.name: Recoverable Throwables 1.5 v2.0
ModMetaData.author: Allen / ChatGPT
ModMetaData.description: Stable RimWorld 1.5 patch for finite recoverable physical thrown weapons. Javelins, throwing axes, throwing knives and similar weapons are stackable, newly generated pawns spawn with multiple copies in their equipped stack, one real weapon is consumed per throw, and that exact item is recovered where the projectile ends. Explosive grenade-style throwables remain handled separately by Grenade One-Use v1.1.
